events.title: Atlantic City Boardwalk
events.blurb: The original boardwalk: 5.5 miles of ocean views, arcades, saltwater taffy and casinos.
events.blurbEs: El paseo marítimo original: 9 km de vistas al mar, salones de juegos, caramelos y casinos.

events.title: Kem
events.blurb: The Detroit R&B singer behind “Love Calls” and “Share My Life” plays Borgata on Black Friday night.
events.blurbEs: El cantante de R&B de Detroit, autor de “Love Calls” y “Share My Life”, se presenta en el Borgata la noche del Black Friday.

events.title: Chris Isaak: On Tour for the Holidays
events.blurb: The “Wicked Game” crooner brings his holiday tour, mixing rockabilly hits with Christmas songs, to the intimate Music Box.
events.blurbEs: El cantante de “Wicked Game” trae su gira navideña, con éxitos de rockabilly y canciones de Navidad, al íntimo Music Box.

events.title: The Temptations and The Four Tops
events.venue: Hard Rock Live at Etess Arena
events.blurb: Two Motown legends share one bill on Black Friday: “My Girl,” “I Can’t Help Myself” and a night of sing-alongs.
events.blurbEs: Dos leyendas de Motown comparten escenario el Black Friday: “My Girl”, “I Can’t Help Myself” y una noche para cantar juntos.

events.title: A Magical Cirque Christmas
events.blurb: Acrobats, aerialists, contortionists and jugglers perform to well-known Christmas songs, hosted by magician Mark Clearview. Billed as suitable for all ages.
events.blurbEs: Acróbatas, aerialistas, contorsionistas y malabaristas actúan al ritmo de conocidas canciones navideñas, con el mago Mark Clearview como anfitrión. Apto para todas las edades.

events.title: Jason Bonham’s Led Zeppelin Evening
events.blurb: John Bonham’s son leads a full-throttle night of Led Zeppelin songs in Hard Rock’s Sound Waves room.
events.blurbEs: El hijo de John Bonham encabeza una noche a todo volumen con canciones de Led Zeppelin en la sala Sound Waves del Hard Rock.

events.title: Santa’s Hideaway Adventure
events.blurb: Ride an “elevator to the North Pole” at The Shops at The Row, then meet Santa and take photos. Advance tickets recommended; it sells out.
events.blurbEs: Sube a un “elevador al Polo Norte” en The Shops at The Row y conoce a Santa con fotos incluidas. Conviene comprar boletos con anticipación: se agotan.

events.title: Ocean’s Holiday Village
events.blurb: Opening day of Ocean’s holiday market at The Shops at The Row, with more than 30 local businesses; the first 200 shoppers get a limited-edition gift.
events.blurbEs: Primer día del mercado navideño de Ocean en The Shops at The Row, con más de 30 negocios locales; los primeros 200 compradores reciben un regalo de edición limitada.
